cohort: Male dichorionic-diamniotic twins born with hypospadias and positive for cocaine metabolites in their urine.
finding: This case report highlights the co-occurrence of hypospadias and positive cocaine metabolites in twins, suggesting a potential under-recognized association between maternal cocaine use and congenital anomalies like hypospadias.
mod_finding: The male dichorionic-diamniotic twins were born by caesarean section.
